sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।अचिरेण आश्रमम् भ्रातुः चकार सुमहाबलः ॥३-१५-२०॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।acireṇa āśramam bhrātuḥ cakāra sumahābalaḥ ॥3-15-20॥

translations.english: Thus directed by Rama, the mighty Lakshmana, destroyer of enemy warriors, soon built a hermitage for his brother.
